say:1:1130329001:1.text: Orson is a good fighter, but his vision is cloudy and muddled.
say:1:1130329001:1.source_cn: 也不是，奥格是个好战士，但他的眼光有问题。
say:1:1130329001:1.male: Orson is a good fighter, but his vision is cloudy and muddled.
say:1:1130329001:1.female: Orson is a good fighter, but his vision is cloudy and muddled.

say:2:1130329002:1.text: He sent me here on sentry duty when I could be of far more use doing something else.
say:2:1130329002:1.source_cn: 比如我，他只是打发我到这里的岗哨，我明明可以去做更有意...
say:2:1130329002:1.male: He sent me here on sentry duty when I could be of far more use doing something else.
say:2:1130329002:1.female: He sent me here on sentry duty when I could be of far more use doing something else.

say:3:1130329003:1.text: I'm sure if Kruger was in charge he'd find more meaningful tasks for one like me.
say:3:1130329003:1.source_cn: 我相信如果克鲁格是领袖，他一定会对我有更好的安排。
say:3:1130329003:1.male: I'm sure if Kruger was in charge he'd find more meaningful tasks for one like me.
say:3:1130329003:1.female: I'm sure if Kruger was in charge he'd find more meaningful tasks for one like me.
